categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Wallet RPCs belong to wallet unless altering the RPC machinery itself, and no RPC area label is present.
categories.rationale: This PR adds a wallet-specific endpoint (`rebroadcastwallettx`) rather than modifying RPC framework machinery.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Adds a `rebroadcastwallettx` wallet RPC method and a corresponding GUI context menu action for unconfirmed wallet transactions.
categories.rationale: Adds a dedicated wallet RPC and GUI option to manually rebroadcast unconfirmed transactions. As noted in the description citing discussion in #36403, users currently have to manually extract the raw transaction hex and invoke `sendrawtransaction`.
